task: SXS Binary Black Hole Waveform Catalog Accuracy Analysis
scientific_goal: Characterize numerical uncertainties in BBH waveform catalog across resolutions, spherical harmonic modes, and extrapolation orders

datasets.fig6_data.csv: Overall waveform differences between highest resolutions (1500 simulations, log-normal distribution)
datasets.fig7_data.csv: Mode-by-mode waveform differences for ell=2 through ell=8 (1500x7 matrix)
datasets.fig8_data.csv: Extrapolation order comparisons N2vsN3 and N2vsN4 (1200x2 matrix)

methods: Descriptive statistics (median, mean, std, percentiles) for each dataset
Distribution fitting: verify log-normal assumption via Q-Q plots and KS tests
Modal error trend analysis: quantify error increase with ell
Extrapolation convergence analysis: compare N2vsN3 vs N2vsN4 distributions
Cumulative distribution analysis: fraction of simulations below accuracy thresholds
